body:
Test notes from a manual run of this branch:
- A thick violet wedge shows at low view angles on a picked face. It is not from this PR: `main` at acd5b02d3 (without this PR) shows the same wedge, and v0.24.0 does not. It comes from the pick-highlight rewrite (#2256). Filed as #3024.
- The line width and anti-aliasing rows are in the Theme door for now. A better place for the display and graphics settings is proposed in #3025 (one Settings window). If the maintainer decides that, the rows move there in that work.

<!-- pr-reviewer: bdea342b62ec715a4012cfc7be39ef8d3e1f986b -->
### Review of #2989 at bdea342b6: read, not built - needs a maintainer look

The runner refused this build. The author is not a collaborator with push
access, and the workflow does not build fork code on the maintainer's
runner. The reviewer had no local build slot. So no test ran on this head.
A trial-merge gate is needed before a merge.

What the read found:

- The change is well split. The wide-line draw code moves from
  `viewport.rs` into `viewport/wide.rs` and `viewport/pipes.rs`. The
  composite path in `trace/composite.rs` clips to the near plane first.
  The reviewer checked the panic rule: no `unwrap` or `expect` outside
  tests in this diff. `gpu_init.rs` returns a `Result` with a clear
  message.
- Project file: the two new view fields carry `#[serde(default)]`, and an
  unknown word reads as the default. `view_file.rs` tests an older file
  and a newer file. That passes the compatibility rule.
- The line-width and anti-aliasing entries sit in the Display menu's
  Graphics group, after the projection. They are view state, a direct
  field write. That matches how the projection entry already works.
- A refusal exists: the menu refuses a sample count the device does not
  offer (`antialias_refusal`). Good.
- Tests: `display_quality.rs` (structural), `wide_tests.rs`,
  `gpu_render/wide_lines.rs`, `trace_composite.rs`. No snapshot PNG
  change.
- The body has before/after screenshots, a Changelog line, `Fixes
  #2958`, and a decisions file. The clean-room rule holds: the line
  drawing is written from the graphics API, not from HSMWorks material.
- Note: `crates/ui/src/viewport.rs` is 1270 lines. It is over the 400-line
  rule. This PR shrinks it; a follow-up issue for the rest is the right
  fix, not a blocker here.

Verdict: no blockers in the read. Build and test result: not known.
Label: needs-maintainer (the owner decides: grant a build slot, or run the
trial-merge gate).

Correction to my test notes above: the line width and anti-aliasing rows are no longer in the Theme door. Commit bdea342b6 moved them to the viewport's Display menu, in its Graphics group, after the projection. The PR body and `docs/decisions/2958-wide-overlay-lines.md` say this. #3025 still proposes one Settings window for these settings later.
